# CEL policy exceptions for autogenerated Pod controllers

<!-- TODO: Update the Kyverno website's Policy Exceptions and autogen guides
with an example for Deployments and CronJobs and an upgrade note. See
kyverno/kyverno#18702. -->

[Kyverno PR #18702](https://github.com/kyverno/kyverno/pull/18702) fixes how
`PolicyException` matches workloads covered by autogenerated `MutatingPolicy`
and `ImageValidatingPolicy` variants. Write exception conditions using Pod
paths. For example, Kyverno rewrites `object.spec.containers` to
`object.spec.template.spec.containers` for a Deployment and to
`object.spec.jobTemplate.spec.template.spec.containers` for a CronJob.

For these rewritten variants, `object.metadata.name` and
`object.metadata.namespace` still refer to the controller. Extraction mode
continues to evaluate the original expressions against a synthesized Pod.

After upgrading, review existing exceptions for these policies. A matching
workload that previously received a mutation or underwent image validation
can now skip that policy evaluation.

The same fix also preserves braces inside CEL strings and comments when
autogenerating `MutatingPolicy` apply configuration expressions.
